notes.title: Results of the contest!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Today, as announced earlier, we are summarizing the results of the contest "The Best Man in the World" according to the version of ARjunaGames! And to be more precise, we choose the brave man who did not fear fatigue, overcoming sleep and hunger, helped us make the game a little better!

So! *drum roll* .. *fanfares* .. And the winner of this month is - our friend Private Armcoon!!! *long applause*

As a sign of our love and gratitude, we send him straight to Malaysia, our brand-name hoody with studio logo and autographs of developers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/20e3815d00dbbc9f9d1eececfed2b5a3cb9691e8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.834
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/efbcd1959504b84f5521e673dfdc6a9c24fa47d3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/2089ac070a6e650deb3714c9dead95ea27a67445.png[/img][/url]
1. Fixed errors in the textures of objects
2. The bug with the movement on the map section in the Garage location has been fixed.
3. Fixed a bug of reducing the force of the artillery shot
4. Changed the volume of some sounds
5. Fixed some errors in the text. Thank the players for the help!

notes.title: Results of the first week
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/4f3116ecfebeabcf26232039eafbd399e82eeb4b.png[/img]
Summing up the first week after the release of the game in the early access, we want to say to all of you thank you very much for supporting the project! Many players wrote to us who want to help with the development of the game. We really appreciate your contribution! As promised, every month we will choose the most active players who made the greatest contribution to the development of the game, and reward them for their contribution.
If you want to help us with the voice acting or the quality translation of texts in the game into your native language - necessarily to write us about it.

notes.title: Update 0.833
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/efbcd1959504b84f5521e673dfdc6a9c24fa47d3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/2089ac070a6e650deb3714c9dead95ea27a67445.png[/img][/url]
1. Fixed the error of the appearance of enemy soldiers near the barracks
2. Fixed a bug with the announcement of a new rank
3. The parameter of medical treatment is reduced
4. Changed the volume of some sounds

notes.title: Update 0.832
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/efbcd1959504b84f5521e673dfdc6a9c24fa47d3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/2089ac070a6e650deb3714c9dead95ea27a67445.png[/img][/url]
1. After placing the first soldier on the battlefield, the time when opponents do not attack you is increased.
2. Fixed a bug with the location of scouts of the enemy, which made it impossible to pass through the cage where it is located.
3. Increased pause between dialogs, for ease of reading.
4. The sniper began to shoot even more accurately.

notes.title: Update 0.831
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/efbcd1959504b84f5521e673dfdc6a9c24fa47d3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/2089ac070a6e650deb3714c9dead95ea27a67445.png[/img][/url]

1. Fixed a bug where Medics could not treat each other
2. Fixed displaying of names of units and buildings in different languages

notes.title: Update 0.83
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/efbcd1959504b84f5521e673dfdc6a9c24fa47d3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/2089ac070a6e650deb3714c9dead95ea27a67445.png[/img][/url]
1. Fixed bugs with movement on some maps
2. The complexity of the levels is increased. Starting with 4 missions, the headquarters of the enemy will periodically create new units officer, if he is not on the map
3. Parameters of healing by medic is changed. The Medic has become more effective.
4. Fixed the size of Chinese font display in dialogs
5. Fixed displaying of the name of buildings for all languages
6. Changed the volume of the final music after the battle

notes.title: Sniper
notes.content:
An old-fashioned greatcoat.. he got it from his grandfather, but it don't prevent him to hit the button from a distance of 30 matchboxes. Recharged like lightning. At night he don't sleep and prepares his weapon for battle. Take care of the sniper, he is useful to you for the destruction of officers, machine gunners and snipers of the enemy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/f283686a671cdbcb8082a6322afa8955d9e2cb7f.png[/img]

notes.title: Medic
notes.content:
The Medic is the friendliest in the team.  He always smiles, hand out plastic chocolate to all for relieve stress, jokes all the time and tells the story that in his previous life he was a true certified psychologist... Hard to believe but the main thing is that his plastic chocolates really cure plastic wounds. This soldier is especially useful where you need to hold out as long as possible under the heavy fire of the enemy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/469e6163061e41de417dbc7e7e8d493926c88f73.png[/img]

notes.title: Grenadier
notes.content:
The soldier with the devil-trumpet is the most neat.... aaa no no, it's not about him... This one sorts out everything that he sees to small pieces, he like a repairman-gadabout. If the enemy needs to "repair the equipment" or "help dismantle the reinforcement," then you can safely send your grenade launcher to this part of the map

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/0e5e9c375d2700e675e2e97d2fd8a2b5c7ac28ba.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Machine-gunner
notes.content:
The machine-gunner is the quietest in the sqad. If he does not fight, he usually sleeps, eats or looks at an aquarium with fish. And when he is fighting - it's just a demon 😡, he shoots at anything that moves until it stops moving. And then he looks at the aquarium again ..

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/003650a43acc737dfe2f2f31a2817fe355eff4f3.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
The officer on the battlefield is able to raise the morale of the soldiers standing nearby. A strong man's word to their subordinates sometimes makes them show outstanding results!
